standard.name: MIMS
standard.abstract: A checklist / metadata standard for metagenome or environmental samples. It describes material samples collected from environments (soil, water, air, etc.) with fields for geographic location, collection time, environmental descriptors, sample processing, nucleic acid extraction and sequencing, and downstream assembly/annotation metadata. The recording/data modality is structured metadata (checklist/table) intended to accompany sequence data submissions.

classification.rationale: MIMS is published as a checklist (MIGS/MIMS) containing a structured table of fields (slots) with cardinality, types and definitions; the source material shows a full itemized checklist and spreadsheet of metadata fields.
